mapper.sql: transfer_orders.id AS id, transfer_orders.from_location_group_id AS fromWarehouseId, lg_from.name AS fromWarehouseName, transfer_orders.to_location_group_id AS toWarehouseId, lg_to.name AS toWarehouseName, transfer_orders.to_code AS toNumber, transfer_orders.order_date AS toDate, transfer_orders.fulfillment_date AS fulfillmentDate, transfer_orders.status AS status, transfer_orders.type AS `type`, transfer_orders.created AS created, transfer_orders.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM transfer_orders LEFT JOIN location_groups AS lg_from ON lg_from.id = transfer_orders.from_location_group_id LEFT JOIN location_groups AS lg_to ON lg_to.id = transfer_orders.to_location_group_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = transfer_orders.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = transfer_orders.modified_by

transfer_orders.id AS id, transfer_orders.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, transfer_orders.from_location_group_id AS fromWarehouseId, lg_from.name AS fromWarehouseName, transfer_orders.to_location_group_id AS toWarehouseId, lg_to.name AS toWarehouseName, transfer_orders.to_code AS toNumber, transfer_orders.order_date AS toDate, transfer_orders.fulfillment_date AS fulfillmentDate, transfer_receive_results.date AS `date`, transfer_receive_results.code AS code, transfer_orders.status AS status, transfer_orders.note AS memo, transfer_orders.type AS `type`, transfer_orders.created AS created, transfer_orders.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM transfer_orders LEFT JOIN transfer_receive_results ON transfer_receive_results.transfer_order_id = transfer_orders.id LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = transfer_orders.company_id LEFT JOIN location_groups AS lg_from ON lg_from.id = transfer_orders.from_location_group_id LEFT JOIN location_groups AS lg_to ON lg_to.id = transfer_orders.to_location_group_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = transfer_orders.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = transfer_orders.modified_by
mapper.select: SELECT code FROM transfer_receive_results WHERE YEAR(created) = YEAR(NOW()) AND code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE request_stocks SET status = 3 WHERE id IN (SELECT request_stock_id FROM transfer_orders WHERE id = #{id});
mapper.select: SELECT `value` FROM uom_conversions WHERE from_uom_id = #{uomId} AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transfer_receives ( transfer_order_id, transfer_receive_result_id, transfer_order_detail_id, qty, lots_number, expired_date, product_id, qty_uom_id, conversion, created_by, created, status ) VALUES ( #{receive.transferOrderId}, #{receive.transferReceiveResultId}, #{receive.transferOrderDetailId}, #{receive.qty}, #{receive.lotsNumber}, #{receive.expiredDate}, #{receive.productId}, #{receive.uomId}, #{receive.conversion}, #{userId}, NOW(), 1 );

INSERT INTO transfer_receive_results ( transfer_order_id, code, date, created_by, created ) VALUES ( #{receiveResult.transferOrderId}, #{receiveResult.trNumber}, #{receiveResult.trDate}, #{userId}, NOW() );
mapper.select: SELECT transfer_order_details.id AS id, transfer_order_details.transfer_order_id AS transferOrderId, transfer_order_details.po_no AS poNumber, transfer_order_details.product_id AS productId, products.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, transfer_order_details.expired_date AS expiredDate, products.name AS productName, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, products.unit_cost AS unitCost, transfer_order_details.expired_date AS expiryDate, transfer_order_details.location_from_id AS locationFromId, locations_from.`name` AS locationFromName, transfer_order_details.location_to_id AS locationToId, locations_to.`name` AS locationToName, IFNULL(transfer_order_details.qty,0) AS qtyTransfer, IFNULL(transfer_receives.qty,0) AS qtyReceive, IFNULL(transfer_receives.conversion,1) AS conversion, transfer_order_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, IFNULL(transfer_order_details.lots_number,'0') AS lotsNumber FROM transfer_order_details LEFT JOIN transfer_receives ON transfer_order_details.id = transfer_receives.transfer_order_detail_id LEFT JOIN products ON transfer_order_details.product_id = products.id LEFT JOIN locations AS locations_from ON transfer_order_details.location_from_id = locations_from.id LEFT JOIN locations AS locations_to ON transfer_order_details.location_to_id = locations_to.id LEFT JOIN uoms ON transfer_order_details.qty_uom_id = uoms.id WHERE transfer_order_details.transfer_order_id = #{transferConsignmentId}

SELECT transfer_order_details.id AS id, transfer_order_details.transfer_order_id AS transferOrderId, transfer_order_details.po_no AS poNumber, transfer_order_details.product_id AS productId, products.unit_cost AS unitCost, transfer_order_details.expired_date AS expiryDate, transfer_order_details.location_from_id AS locationFromId, transfer_order_details.location_to_id AS locationToId, IFNULL(transfer_order_details.qty,0) AS qtyTransfer, IFNULL(transfer_order_details.conversion,1) AS conversion, transfer_order_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, IFNULL(transfer_order_details.lots_number,'0') AS lotsNumber FROM transfer_order_details LEFT JOIN products ON transfer_order_details.product_id = products.id WHERE transfer_order_details.transfer_order_id = #{transferConsignmentId}
